thread:
maya: Quick follow-up on the recent authz incident affecting service-x. Root cause summary: token validation accepted legacy tokens due to schema drift + a permissive role binding that allowed a downstream component to perform elevated calls. We need clear owners for remediation, timelines, and a plan to prevent recurrence. I'll capture assignments here.

adrian: I can take audit logging for service-x. Will open infra PR to enable structured logs and forward to the security index. Plan: enable in staging today, verify log shipping and parser, then roll to prod after canary. ETA: staging changes by Mon EOD, prod by Tue if no issues. PR: https://git.internal/r/adrian/enable-service-x-logging (WIP).
sophie: I'll own permissions hardening. Steps: run a perms-sweep report, add explicit deny rules for the risky endpoints, and add unit tests around the permission matrix. Need ~48h for the initial sweep + canary rollout. I'll sync with oncall for a window.

raj: I'll do the secrets rotation and automation. Performed a manual rotation just now and logged it in SEC-2026. I'll add a Vault job to rotate keys weekly and a one-off emergency playbook. Command used: `vault write auth/rotate service-x`. Draft job cron: `0 3 * * 1` (weekly) but can reduce frequency. Automation PR: https://git.internal/r/raj/service-x-rotation.

emily: I'll update the runbook and incident tracker entries. Adding a smoke-test harness: send a suite of synthetic tokens to the token-validation endpoint and assert schema and rejection cases. Also recommend an alert: token-validation error rate > 0.5% over 5m. I'll add the alert in ops-monitoring.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling staging deploy for logging enablement at 1749618000. Will post status when complete.

security-bot: ticket-bot: Created SEC-2026 with subtasks [enable-logs, perms-hardening, rotate-secrets, token-ci-check]. Link: https://sec.internal/SEC-2026.

leo: Noting this resembles two previous incidents this quarter where token schema drift + default-broad roles were a factor. We should add a CI gate that validates token schema compatibility on API changes and a recurring permission audit automation.

adrian: Agree. I'll draft a GitHub Action that validates token schema against the service contract and runs on PRs touching auth or api layers. Aim: prototype by Friday.

sophie: For the perms sweep, I pushed an initial query to infra-utils that lists roles with >3 wildcard permissions and flags service accounts with cross-project access. ETA for initial report: next Wed.

maya: Consolidated action list: 1) Enable audit logs for service-x 12 owner: adrian 12 ETA: staging Mon, prod Tue after canary; 2) Permissions hardening + sweep 12 owner: sophie 12 ETA: sweep Wed, rollouts after review; 3) Secrets rotation + automation 12 owner: raj 12 ETA: manual rotation done, automation PR pending; 4) Token-validation CI gate 12 owner: adrian 12 ETA: Fri prototype; 5) Runbook updates + smoke tests 12 owner: emily 12 ETA: Fri; 6) Dashboard & alerts for validation errors 12 owner: adrian 12 ETA: Mon-Tue. Please add PR links and blockers to SEC-2026. We'll do a quick sync Fri 10:00 to confirm progress.

raj: Manual rotation completed and documented in SEC-2026. PR for automation posted: https://git.internal/r/raj/service-x-rotation. PTAL @sophie @adrian.

adrian: Reviewing rotation PR. Found retention config mismatch for logs; pushing a patch to my logging PR.

sophie: Reviewing rotation PR for permission impacts. Also added perms-sweep draft in infra-utils and linked it in SEC-2026.

emily: Runbook updated: https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/service-x. Added smoke test harness and curl examples for generating valid/invalid tokens. Added alert definition to ops-monitoring: token-validation-failure-rate.

leo: Filing a follow-up epic to standardize token-compat checks and monthly permission sweeps across services; will link to SEC-2026 and create tracking tickets.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers post here and escalate if needed. After the Friday sync, I'll mark items as closed in the tracker with PR/ticket links. :white_check_mark:
